source: An AI model is expressed as tensor operations, but hardware does not execute “a Transformer layer” or “an attention block” as a primitive. Frameworks, compilers, and libraries ultimately turn work into device operations and kernels. Those kernels expose parallel threads, instructions, memory accesses, and synchronization to a ZXNAME0000XZ execution system.[1]
zh: 人工智能模型被表示为张量运算，但硬件不会将“Transformer 层”或“注意力块”作为原语执行。框架、编译器和库最终将工作转化为设备操作和内核。这些内核向 ZXNAME0000XZ 执行系统公开并行线程、指令、内存访问和同步。[1]
